## Welcome

Welcome to the first tutorial of the R Beginners Course of Spatial analysis. We hope that you are ready to try some things out!

## Outline

This tutorial is composed by two exercises:

* Populations in Finland and Sweden
* How much does it rain in Colombian cities?

After the completion of this tutorial you will be able to import, modify, and export data files and extract information from gridded datasets.

## Popultions in Finland and Sweden

You have been provided with two csv files, which contain the populations of all towns and cities with more than 20,000 inhabitants for Finland and Sweden. Create a combined data table with the entries for Finland and Sweden, ordered from the largest population to the smallest population. Write the output table as a csv file.

## How much does it rain in Colombian cities?

In the CHIRPS_monthly folder, we have monthly precipitation rasters from 2000 to 2003. We want to
examine the difference in monthly precipitation between Bogota (4.7, -74.1) and Medellin (6.2, -75.6). The shapefile for Colombia is in the folder Colombia.

 a) Plot the locations of the two cities along with the first monthly precipitation raster, masked
to the extent of Colombia.

 b) Extract the monthly precipitation time series for the two cities.

 c) Plot the two time series as a line chart.

 d) Calculate the differences in monthly precipitation between the two cities.
